name: Darksoul Shackle
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Moonrage Darksouls wear enchanted fetters forged under Archmage Arugal’s direction. Forsaken mages at the Sepulcher seek them to learn how the magic gripping the region can be undone.

sections.title: A Crutch for Faltering Magic
sections.body: Archmage Arugal’s magic could not fully command or sustain the worgen he unleashed upon Silverpine Forest. He bound enchanted implements such as Darksoul Shackles to the beasts to make up for that failing. The fetters channel outside sorcery into the Moonrage Darksouls, strengthening them and anchoring the curse that keeps them thrall to Shadowfang Keep.

sections.title: Kirin Tor Scrutiny
sections.body: At the Sepulcher, Forsaken mage Dalar Dawnweaver judges Arugal a dangerous incompetent. He believes Arugal’s meddling ruined the Kirin Tor’s defense against the Scourge. Forsaken researchers gather Darksoul Shackles and fetters torn from Moonrage Gluttons, then draw out the enchantments left in the metal. Studying them exposes flaws in Arugal’s spellcraft and gives the Forsaken arcane insight to shape a countermeasure against his lupine scourge.

faq.answer: Moonrage Darksoul worgen in Silverpine Forest wear enchanted metal fetters called Darksoul Shackles. Archmage Arugal crafted them to reinforce his spellcraft and bind the beasts to his control.
Dalar Dawnweaver, a Forsaken mage at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, wants Darksoul Shackles. He studies their enchantments to find a solution to Arugal’s worgen outbreak.

faq.q: Where do these shackles come from?
faq.answer: Moonrage Darksouls, aggressive worgen haunting northern and eastern Silverpine Forest, bear these shackles.

faq.q: Why did Arugal put shackles on the worgen?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver says Arugal lacked the talent to command the beasts through sheer power alone. Arugal relied on enchanted objects like these shackles to channel and sustain the volatile magic holding the pack together.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, breaking Arugal’s hold on Silverpine Forest is essential to protecting their southern borders and proving Undercity’s arcane scholarship superior to Dalaran’s failures.
As a mage, you can see how a desperate wizard used crude enchanted artifacts to shore up volatile summoning spells he could not properly control.
